@deskOvNotUpdated.description: Title of the toast on Overview when the refresh could not ask the node; the reason follows as its text.

@deskOvNodeNotStarted.description: Title of the toast on Overview when the built-in node could not be started; the reason follows as its text.

@deskOvNodeAddrTitle.description: Title of a notice on Overview: the saved node address was corrected.

@deskOvNodeAddrText.description: Text of the notice about the corrected node address. The addresses stay as written.

@deskOvNodeIncompatTitle.description: Title of a red notice on Overview: the node runs a version the wallet cannot use.

@deskOvNodeUrl.description: Text of the incompatible-node notice: the node's address.

@deskOvUsePublicNode.description: Button in the incompatible-node notice: switch to the public node. Short.

@deskOvUseLocalNode.description: Button in the incompatible-node notice: switch to the node built into the app. Short.

@deskOvHide.description: Ghost button in the incompatible-node notice: dismiss it. Short.

@deskOvCantReachNode.description: Title of a red notice on Overview: the node does not answer.

deskOvCantReachNodeText: Balances may be out of date. Check the node, or choose another in Node settings.

@deskOvCantReachNodeText.description: Text of the notice that the node does not answer.

@deskOvStarting.description: Label of the Start node button while the node is starting. One word.

@deskOvStartNode.description: Button in the node-down notice: start the built-in node. Short.

@deskOvNodeSettings.description: Ghost button in the node-down notice: opens Settings for the node. Short.

@deskOvTitle.description: Title of the Overview page: balance and recent activity.

@deskOvShowAmounts.description: Tooltip of the icon button on Overview that shows the hidden amounts.

@deskOvHideAmounts.description: Tooltip of the icon button on Overview that hides amounts.

@deskOvRefresh.description: Tooltip of the icon button on Overview that asks the node for new data.

@deskOvStepDone.description: Screen reader state of a start-up step that is finished. Lower case, follows the step's text.

@deskOvStepNow.description: Screen reader state of a start-up step that is running. Lower case, follows the step's text.

@deskOvStepWait.description: Screen reader state of a start-up step that has not started. Lower case, follows the step's text.

@deskOvStepSemantics.description: Screen reader label of a start-up step: its text and its state.

@deskOvStartingUp.description: Screen reader label of the group of start-up steps shown after unlocking.

@deskOvStepUnlocked.description: Start-up step shown on Overview after unlocking.

@deskOvStepConnected.description: Start-up step shown on Overview after unlocking.

@deskOvStepUpdating.description: Start-up step shown on Overview after unlocking.

@deskOvStepEpicbox.description: Start-up step shown on Overview after unlocking.

@deskOvSyncTitle.description: Title of a notice on Overview while the node catches up with the network.

@deskOvSyncProgress.description: Screen reader label of the sync progress bar.

@deskOvSyncOfChain.description: Caption under the sync progress bar.

@deskOvReceiveEpic.description: Primary button on Overview of an empty wallet: opens Receive. Short.

@deskOvSend.description: Primary button on Overview: opens Send. Short.

@deskOvReceive.description: Button on Overview: opens Receive. Short.

@deskOvScan.description: Button on Overview beside Send and Receive that reads any code with the camera.

deskOvSendWaits: Sending resumes when the node is synced.

@deskOvSendWaits.description: Small text under the buttons on Overview while Send is disabled until the node is synced.

deskOvSendWaitsNode: Sending resumes when the node answers.

@deskOvSendWaitsNode.description: Small text under the buttons on Overview while Send is disabled because the node does not answer.

@deskOvBalance.description: Label above the big balance amount on Overview: the wallet's balance (what can be spent, plus payments and the wallet's own change still confirming). Same word as the phone's homeWalletBalance.

@deskOvSpendableNow.description: Line under Overview's big balance while part of it is still confirming (the change of a send, a payment in a block): what Send can use now. amount is the EPIC amount with its unit.

@deskOvAsOfBlock.description: Small tag next to the balance: the balance is as of this block height.

deskOvEmptyHint: Share the Epicbox address to receive the first EPIC.

@deskOvEmptyHint.description: Text under the balance of an empty wallet.

@deskOvFiatNote.description: Small grey text after the dollar value of the whole balance on Overview. Starts with two spaces.

@deskOvBreakTotal.description: Label of a balance cell under the big amount on Overview: the whole balance. Narrow cell, may wrap to two lines.

@deskOvBreakConfirming.description: Label of a balance cell on Overview: money still waiting for confirmations. Narrow cell.

@deskOvBreakImmature.description: Label of a balance cell on Overview: mining rewards not yet spendable. Narrow cell.

@deskOvBreakAwaiting.description: Label of a balance cell on Overview: money of payments that wait to be finalized. Narrow cell, may wrap to two lines.

@deskOvBreakLocked.description: Label of a balance cell on Overview: money locked in unfinished sends. Narrow cell, may wrap to two lines.

@deskOvUpdating.description: Tag next to the balance label while the balance is being updated; also its screen reader label. One word.

@deskOvHiddenAmount.description: Screen reader label of the balance when amounts are hidden.

@deskOvLoading.description: Line with a spinner in the Recent activity panel while the transactions load.

@deskOvEmptyTitle.description: Title of the empty state of Recent activity.

deskOvEmptyText: {blocks, plural, one{Received EPIC shows as confirming, then spendable after {blocks} confirmation.} other{Received EPIC shows as confirming, then spendable after {blocks} confirmations.}}

@deskOvEmptyText.description: Text of the empty state of Recent activity; blocks is the number of confirmations needed.

@deskOvShowAddress.description: Primary button in the empty state of Recent activity: opens Receive.

@deskOvReceiveFile.description: Ghost button in the empty state of Recent activity: opens the page to import a payment file.

@deskOvRecent.description: Heading above the last transactions on Overview.

@deskOvViewAll.description: Link next to the Recent activity heading: opens Activity; count is the number of transactions.

deskOvInflightMore: {count, plural, one{{count} more payment under way} other{{count} more payments under way}}

@deskOvInflightMore.description: Last line under Overview's payments under way when there are more than the card and three rows: how many are not shown. Dim text, a View link beside it.

@deskOvInflightView.description: Link beside the line about more payments under way on Overview: opens Activity on its Pending filter.

deskOvPendingFiles: {count, plural, one{{count} file payment to finalize} other{{count} file payments to finalize}}

@deskOvPendingFiles.description: Title of a notice on Overview: file payments waiting for the recipient's response file.

deskOvPendingText: Finalize with the response file from the recipient.

@deskOvPendingText.description: Text of the notice about open file sends.

@deskOvFinalize.description: Ghost button in the open-file-sends notice: opens the Finalize page. Short.
